chunks: And the King said: 'I see seven fat cows being eaten by seven lean ones, and seven green ears of corn and seven others dry. O men of high rank, interpret for me my vision, if you are indeed skilled in interpretation.'
ai.seo_question: What did the King of Egypt dream about that required interpretation?
ai.summary: In this verse, the King of Egypt recounts his dream to his courtiers, seeking an interpretation for the vision of seven fat cows eaten by seven lean ones and seven green ears of grain alongside seven dry ones. This narrative sets the stage for Prophet Joseph’s (Yusuf) divine insight, which interprets the dream as a prophecy of seven years of abundance followed by seven years of famine, a theme central to the story's resolution.
